backend.tls: Caddy on :443, Let's Encrypt ACME (HTTP-01 disabled). No :80 listener; HTTP redirects are disabled.

auth.tokenFormat: Opaque shared secret from the DESK_TOKEN env var. Any non-empty trimmed UTF-8 string. Not a JWT and not an Authorization Bearer token. Compared with SHA-256 plus timing-safe equality. The value is never logged and must never be committed.
auth.whenUnset: If DESK_TOKEN is empty or whitespace, the gate stays open (local-open). Production has a token set.

clients.android: Paste the token on the Link screen (stored as preference desk_token). Every HTTP call sends header X-Desk-Token and also appends ?token= (URL-encoded). The WebSocket opens wss://<host>/ws?token= and also sets the header.
clients.web: A first visit may carry ?token=. The page copies it into sessionStorage key night-desk-token, then strips it from the address bar. Later fetches send header X-Desk-Token and also set the query param. Authorization: Bearer is not accepted.
clients.serverCookie: On every authorized response the desk also sets HttpOnly cookie desk_token; Path=/; SameSite=Lax; Max-Age=2592000, so a browser session can keep working after the query string is removed.

hardRules: AI auto-buys stay paper-only. liveAutoBuy cannot be turned on; POST /api/settings with liveAutoBuy=true is refused. liveScope is manual: operator buys, limits and stops may send real swaps; AI never spends live. The engine is paper only by default. Since 13.40 the owner can set one engine variant live (liveVariant on POST /api/strategy/settings); it is off until set, uses every live limit, and any other AI live buy is still refused (LIVE_AI_BLOCKED).

The desk hard stop is checked before an engine exit. A mark at or past that stop closes as STOP_LOSS or GAP_RUG. The engine stop (1% on the main paper book) can only be tighter. Since 13.39 it is measured from the entry mark, like the hard stop, not from the fill. The $10 UTC-day paper-loss pause stays (STRATEGY.dailyMaxLossUsd).
Never drop the v13.11 baseline controls: paper and live limit / take-profit / stop orders (GET/POST /api/orders, POST /api/orders/cancel), and the rest of the v13.11 book and ticket UI.

Bogus-price rejection stays on (src/market/mark-guard.ts). Unusable marks (non-finite or ≤0) are rejected. Implausible upward jumps and unit/decimal or SOL-vs-USD mix-ups (including a rise of 25× or more) do not update equity or stops unless confirmed. A genuine crash or rug is never rejected by this guard, so the stop can still fire.
The hard stop cannot be loosened past 6%. LIVE_TRADING, the wallet secret, and mode cannot be changed from the API.
Do not print secrets. RPC URLs may carry API keys in the path or query; publish hostnames only.
Every Night Desk release PR must update docs/DESK_SETTINGS.md and docs/desk-settings.json in the same PR so these files stay current.

13.30: the trading engine trades the paper book only. Its buys go through the analyst path, which refuses the live book. The engine stop can only sit tighter than the hard stop and never moves it. The scorecard ready flag arms nothing.
13.31 keeps that engine. It does not add a live order path, move the hard stop, change the Helius 10/8 caps, or change the live $5/$20 limits.

13.32: an explicit manual paper or live buy (POST /api/positions/buy) bypasses the engine watch (SIGNAL_WATCH), analyst score, soft filter kills, and the hard-stop ban. A resting limit fill does not skip that ban. The fill logs MANUAL_OVERRIDE and may include a warning. Hard kills still need Buy anyway (confirmHardKill), including on the live book. The engine and AI stay paper-only. The $5 default, $20 daily cap, wallet check, slippage, pool depth, idempotency, operator auth, and bogus-price rejection are unchanged. No new Helius cap and no new engine live path.

13.33: poll latency only. equity(ts) index, SQL downsample to <=240 points. The cache keeps time buckets and widens them as the session grows. Snapshots carry seq; clients ignore an older snapshot, and a position mark drops the 1s cache. GET /api/orders and GET /api/settings skip the full snapshot. GET /api/wallet is non-blocking (balanceAgeMs, balanceStale). Live buys wait at most 4s then a 60s successful cache or refuse. Live sells may use an older successful SOL figure. Helius priority-0 queue max 24 with oldest-first drop and stale duplicate-mint drop. Caps stay 10+8. No trading, filter, slippage, cooldown, or engine-pause number changed.

13.34: pre-filter only. Cheap kills (volume, liquidity, age, ban, junk name, bogus price, already killed) run before Helius/Alchemy. No numeric filter or trade setting changed. Caps stay 10+8. Rebased onto main 08233e1 (PR 33, includes 5cca6d92).
13.35: phone redesign only (five tabs, Engine tab, Settings → More). Adds strategy.mainOpen (engine positions on the main paper book). No desk setting, limit or trading behavior changed.

13.39: live sell NO_ROUTES / drained quote-side / exit impact answers in a few seconds with a clear reason. Phone live sells use the 45s client and show the reason, not timeout. A stale Dex mid is not sellable value when the quote side is gone. Position stays open for a retry. No Sell anyway over 6%. No numeric trading or filter setting changed. Caps stay 10+8. Based on main 9bd6967 (PR 41).

13.38: manual paper and live buys use launchBundleSoon (1.5s) instead of an uncapped launchBundle. Unenriched quote and curve fallbacks, and ensureDepth's curve read, are also capped. No numeric trading or filter setting changed. Caps stay 10+8. Based on main 929365c (PR 39).

13.37: DAMM v2 is not a traditional LP lock. Rank traditional pools by real depth. A figure-less pool does not fail a coin that has another pool with data. Holder count is RugCheck totalHolders, not a top-20 sample; unknown stays fail-closed. No numeric trading or filter setting changed. Caps stay 10+8. Based on main 7c00007 (PR 38).

13.36: lookup chain, primary-pool LP lock, unverified-kill counts, hard stop measured from the entry mark. No numeric trading or filter setting changed. Caps stay 10+8. Rebased onto main bfd761a (PR 36, the 13.35 redesign).

13.51: a holding whose mark has collapsed (under $0.01 and 99% below entry, or a 99% drop seen three times at least 1.5s apart) or whose read-only Jupiter sell quote finds no pool shows Liquidity gone, no sell route, without a sell attempt. Pump-route coins are not judged by that quote. Nothing is sent. Stops, settings, and the ledger stay. No numeric setting changed.

13.50: a live sell in the first 30 seconds after a fill sends the confirmed buy amount when the wallet balance or token-account read is stale, empty, or still in flight, instead of refusing. A real token balance still caps the sell. Exit slippage stays 6%. Caps stay 10 and 8. Positions marked liquidity gone move to a collapsed Dead / no sell route section and stay sellable. A manual Sell anyway can pass the exit cap for that tap; engine exits cannot. No route says the pool is drained. No numeric setting changed.

13.49: the launch-bundle check reads only the coin's own launch-slot transactions (one batched getTransaction request, at most 10) and falls back to the whole-slot getBlock when there are more or the batch is incomplete. Same rule, same thresholds, no numeric setting changed.

13.48: the engine live launch-bundle getBlock asks for transactionDetails accounts (rewards false, maxSupportedTransactionVersion 0). Token balances still flag the 20% share. Parsed SOL transfers are not in that block. A timeout and an RPC error log as separate reasons, both LAUNCH_BUNDLE_UNVERIFIED. Marks and other background reads leave HELIUS_FRONT_RESERVE slots so priority -1 safety and bundle reads are not queued behind them. Caps stay 10 and 8. No numeric setting changed.

13.47: engine token-safety reads wait 8s and the live launch-bundle check waits 15s before failing closed. The one-live-buy lock covers only the buy. A shorter in-flight read that answers Safe or Blocked is kept. Caps stay 10 and 8. Manual-buy timeouts and every numeric setting are unchanged.

13.46: a buy's safety and bundle reads (priority -1) no longer wait for a Helius read-lane token. They skip the token bucket, never the 10/min ceiling, and priority-2 background reads stop at 7/min so 3 sends a minute stay free. Lane ceilings stay 10 and 8, 18 together.

13.45: engine token-safety reads and the live engine launch-bundle check use priority -1 on the Helius read lane. A priority -1 buy does not reuse a cached Unknown or wait on a background read of the same coin. A bundle timeout or error skips that live buy (LAUNCH_BUNDLE_UNVERIFIED). Other non-pause skips log ENGINE_LIVE_SKIP. A timed-out safety read is dropped from the queue. Caps stay 10 and 8. No numeric setting changed.

13.44: strategy.live reports why the live engine is not buying (signals, otherSignals, buys, lastSkip, spentTodayUsd, dailyCapUsd). maxTradesPerHour counts live buys only for an engine live buy. No other limit or default changed.
13.43: the $10 UTC-day paper-loss pause applies to paper engine buys only and does not stop a live engine buy. The $5 closed-live pause is unchanged.

13.42: desk follow-up to 13.41. Live equity curve no longer re-reads its table per sample (rows kept 90 days); gzip honours q=0; replay yields on every quote; held ticks with a depth change are saved. No rule, limit, default, endpoint or setting changed.

13.41: liveBook.equity (live equity curve, sampled only on a good wallet read). Market recorder: MARKET_RECORD_DAYS (default 14, 0 = off, max 90) saves engine quotes and signals to market_quotes / market_signals; GET /api/market/quotes (JSON or CSV), /api/market/signals, /api/market/replay (exit-rule grid on saved data, read-only). JSON replies gzipped. No trading rule, limit or default changed.

13.40: 18 shadow books (12 trailing: 3% stop, then a 4/8/12% trail under the high, f = fade exits on volume, sellers, stall and pool depth). New exit codes ENGINE_TRAIL, PROFIT_LOCK, FADE_EXIT, LIQUIDITY_DROP. New engine setting liveVariant (default null): that one variant also buys live at liveTradeUsd with the take-profit scaled to the live size, behind operatorReady, the daily cap, wallet checks and a $5 live-loss pause per UTC day. Hard stop, 10+8 caps and live $5/$20 defaults unchanged.

13.39: Home charts on the phone, and the math audit: the engine stop is measured from the entry mark (not the fill), fractional hard-stop labels are exact, engine positions show the engine stop. No setting, endpoint or limit changed. Reset the scorecard after deploying.

standingPipeline: Wait for hosted CI to finish green on the exact PR head. If CI fails, report it; do not silently fix it.
Review the diff against the hard rules (AI paper-only, live $5/$20, stops/trail/6% exit slippage, cooldown 0, bogus-price rejection, Helius caps, no secret leakage).
Squash-merge, then confirm the merge tree matches the tested head tree.

Build the APK and re-sign it with the existing Android debug certificate sha256 2c69c1b3d33c812142bf0d214e890e084227f01c84f234a8246f2acc7d111f04. Publish a GitHub release vX.Y with NightDesk-vX.Y-debug.apk and a private Drive copy.
Back up Oracle, deploy the merged tree to /opt/night-desk-releases/<merge sha>, leave /etc/night-desk/night-desk.env unchanged, and restart only the night-desk service.
Watch the desk and report version, pipeline, paper cash/equity, live book (0 unexpected spends), and provider error counts.

filterSemantics1329.holders: When enrich only sees the top 20 accounts (Alchemy today; HOLDER_PAGES_MAX=0), a full list of 20 counts as 20 or more.

filterSemantics1329.recheck: 13.34: a volume, liquidity, or age miss is remembered and does not enter the RPC recheck queue. It gets one free-feed look after 5 minutes, and only if volume has grown past the floor. Holder soft misses still get one RPC recheck. Counts are on /api/state.recheck (pending, ran, dropped).
